question_text: According to the Liskov Substitution Principle (LSP), which of the following is an unacceptable modification when subclassing?

options.text: Strengthening preconditions in the subclass method
Weakening preconditions in the subclass method
Strengthening postconditions in the subclass method
Throwing fewer exception types than the superclass

answer_explanation: LSP requires that subtype methods must not demand more (strengthen preconditions) than the parent type, as existing client code written for the parent contract would break.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: A. Rationale: LSP requires that subtype methods must not demand more (strengthen preconditions) than the parent type, as existing client code written for the parent contract would break.

criteria.name: Correctness
criteria.description: Selects the exact correct technical option.
